newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end weaker despite favourable auction.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end weaker despite favourable auction.

text.p: 1510 GMT - Swiss bonds ended Thursday lower as the Swiss franc weakened. However the Swiss Treasury's latest issue, a 13-year bond with a 3-1/2 coupon met good demand. * Sept Conf futures ended down 48 basis points at 120.45 * 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yielded 3.400 pct vs 3.358 pct
